The work in Mobileye’s algorithms department is dynamic and involves developing algorithms from the early stages of research through to production, while collaborating with other teams throughout the organization.

This is an exciting and unique opportunity to work with highly talented Linux OS team and be a leader in the development of the Linux as a platform for the Safety Critical Automotive industry.

You will write high-performance, object-oriented C++ code on Mobileye’s proprietary validation OS, interface with low-level drivers, and take a lead role in complex board bring-up processes. If you thrive on solving "impossible" hardware-software puzzles alongside HW engineers, this is the place for you.
